You can't exchange anymore.
scripts.translation:
[宠物管理员]
您已经兑换过 3 次驯服道具了。
不能再兑换了。

scripts.text:
[Cute Pet Manager]
Besides me, there are other
Cute Pet Managers. If you want
to tame other pets, I suggest
you go and see them.
scripts.translation:
[宠物管理员]
除了我之外，还有其他宠物管理员。
如果您想驯服其他宠物，
建议您去找他们看看。

scripts.text:
[Cute Pet Manager]
Hello~! I am a Cute Pet Manager
who is in charge of public relations
for the New Upgraded Cute Pet system.
scripts.translation:
[宠物管理员]
您好～！我是负责宣传新版宠物系统的宠物管理员。

scripts.text:
[Cute Pet Manager]
If you have any concerns regarding
the Cute Pet system I am here to guide you.
Let me know which taming
item you want,
then I will tell you the monster
that you can tame with the item.
scripts.translation:
[宠物管理员]
如果您对宠物系统有任何疑问，我可以为您介绍。告诉我您想要哪种驯服道具，我会告诉您可以用它驯服哪种魔物。

scripts.text:
[Cute Pet Manager]
Also I will explain what materials
you need to bring in order to
get the taming item.
scripts.translation:
[宠物管理员]
我还会告诉您兑换驯服道具需要准备哪些材料。

scripts.text:
[Cute Pet Manager]
If you already brought materials
to exchange for the taming item,
I can exchange it for taming items immediately.
scripts.translation:
[宠物管理员]
如果您已经带齐兑换驯服道具所需的材料，我可以马上为您兑换。

scripts.text:
[Cute Pet Manager]
However, there is a limit
for exchanging taming items.
You can only get taming items
3 times. So please make sure
how many times you have exchanged.
scripts.translation:
[宠物管理员]
不过，驯服道具的兑换次数有限，最多只能兑换 3 次。
请确认自己已经兑换过几次。

scripts.text:

So, which taming item do you want?
Please choose one from the list.
scripts.translation:
[宠物管理员]
那么，您想要哪种驯服道具？
请从列表中选择一项。
